provenance.source: Exact archived2fc5d50e production compiler/serializer, with reused unchanged lock/install/data. No current production code.

note: Ten literal old compiled DTOs cover all14arcs in five composition-valid groups at Employee/CEO. Two-month physical hashes include complete monthly/fleet data; completion means only the requested two-month durability check, not these240-month campaigns. One representative literal old save/replay pair is retained without duplicating ten large forecast timelines. All other raw old envelopes remain in the locked source artifact; no new-engine expectations are used.

facilities.description: Low direct emissions and steady output, but very slow to change

facilities.name: Natural Gas Peaker
facilities.description: A single gas turbine: cheap to build and running in minutes, but it burns about half again as much gas per MWh as a combined cycle

facilities.name: Battery
facilities.description: Quick to build and nearly instant to respond, with limited stored energy

customScenario.name: Frozen legacy arcs
customScenario.summary: Your biggest reactor shuts down without warning. Have backup ready.

briefing.fantasy: Keep the lights on when your largest generator shuts down.
briefing.objective: Have enough generation and storage ready to cover the main reactor's shutdown.
briefing.threat: The shutdown date is hidden. The reactor stays offline for the rest of the mission.

customScenario.endMessage: Losing your biggest reactor left the rest of the grid to cover the gap. See how your backup plan held up.

arcEvents.title: Aging coal slowdown
arcEvents.message: Operating coal plants at least 30 years old are down to 88% output for 24 months.
arcEvents.preview: Aging coal plants producing less power.

arcEvents.title: Aging slowdown ends
arcEvents.message: Paris, France: Review your supply and reserves before the upcoming scenario event.
arcEvents.preview: Temporary limits on older coal plants lifting.

arcEvents.title: Aging coal warning
arcEvents.message: Coal plants that reach 30 years of age in two years will face a temporary output limit. Prepare replacement power.

arcEvents.title: New coal rules begin
arcEvents.message: Paris, France: Coal operating cost: 115% of normal; Coal output: 90% of normal.
arcEvents.preview: Coal plants costing more to run and producing less power.

arcEvents.title: New coal rules announced
arcEvents.message: Paris, France: Review your supply and reserves before the upcoming scenario event.

arcEvents.title: New-grid check-in
arcEvents.message: Review the grid's recorded results for the previous twelve months.
arcEvents.preview: Assessing the move away from coal.

arcEvents.title: Moderate hurricane hits
arcEvents.message: Storm damage reduces affected generator output to 70% for 3 months. Oil prices rise 25%.
arcEvents.preview: Storm damage may reduce plant output and raise oil prices.

arcEvents.title: 2028 hurricane outlook
arcEvents.message: Paris, France: Review your supply and reserves before the upcoming scenario event.

arcEvents.title: Storm repairs complete
arcEvents.message: Storm repairs finish. Affected generator output and oil prices return to normal.
arcEvents.preview: Plant output and oil prices returning to normal.

arcEvents.title: Backup-power review
arcEvents.message: Paris, France: Review your supply and reserves before the upcoming scenario event.

arcEvents.title: Grand Nuclear Unit shuts down
arcEvents.message: The original Grand Nuclear Unit is offline while it remains owned. Replace its power with generation, storage or imports.

arcEvents.title: Wildfire emergency
arcEvents.message: Safety shutoffs disconnect 4% of demand and reduce affected generator output. Repairs continue for 2 months.
arcEvents.preview: Extreme fire weather may force safety shutoffs and limit generation.

arcEvents.title: Red-flag warning
arcEvents.message: Paris, France: Review your supply and reserves before the upcoming scenario event.

arcEvents.title: Wildfire restoration complete
arcEvents.message: Safety shutoffs end and repairs finish. Affected generators return to normal.

arcChoices.title: Wildfire preparedness
arcChoices.prompt: Prepare crews and equipment for January's Santa Ana winds, or keep cash.

options.label: Fund preparedness
options.description: Halve customer disconnections and generator output losses in January and February.
options.message: Preparedness halves January–February disconnections and output losses. Repair costs stay the same.

options.label: Keep cash
options.description: Save cash and accept January and February’s full customer disconnections and generator output losses.
options.message: Cash kept. January–February disconnections, output losses and repair costs apply in full.
